svg.title: Face liveness wireframes: desktop dialog and Android capture screen for each state
svg.desc: Fourteen rows, one per user-interface state of PS04 section 10 plus device error, multiple faces, offline and supervisor override. Each row shows the desktop dialog, the Android screen, the message key and notes. Drawn on an opaque light card so it reads the same on light and dark pages.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face liveness wireframes: desktop dialog and Android capture screen

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One row per state of PS04 section 10 (UI/UX) and four team states. Texts are the English strings of docs/ux/message-catalogue.csv; states, icons and colours follow LivenessUiStateMapper,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: which both clients use. Drawn 2026-10-04. These are wireframes, not screenshots: real screens are in docs/ux/screenshots/ (file names in the last column). Grey shapes stand for the camera image.
